rows.note: Use this for the platform where trains stop and passengers board or get off.

example.english: We are waiting for the train on the platform.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 jyut6 toi4 dang2 gan2 ce1

rows.note: Use this for a software, operating-system, or computing platform.

example.english: This program runs on this platform.
example.traditional: 呢個程式喺呢個平臺行到。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 hai2 ni1 go3 ping4 toi4 haang4 dou2

rows.note: Use this for the raised stage where performances take place.

example.english: They couldn't speak when they first stepped onto the platform.
example.traditional: 佢第一次企上舞臺，緊張到講唔出嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 kei5 soeng6 mou5 toi4 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 gong2 m4 ceot1 je5

rows.note: Use this for the raised platform or lectern area from which a speaker addresses an audience.

example.english: The teacher walked up to the platform and greeted everyone first.
example.traditional: 老師行到講臺前面，先同大家打招呼。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 haang4 dou3 gong2 toi4 cin4 min6 sin1 tung4 daai6 gaa1 daa2 ziu1 fu1
